architecture_modules: core.render_plan: extend the renderer-neutral InlineRun union with the four capability-registered typed runs
core.render_plan: reject unknown inline values at the explicit typed seam
api_contracts: InlineRun includes SoftBreakRun, HardBreakRun, HyperlinkRun, and MathRun
HyperlinkRun exposes text and destination; MathRun exposes latex
SoftBreakRun and HardBreakRun are distinct nominal types
permissions: local-only: no network, credentials, or external service
operational_constraints: renderer-neutral: no docx/lxml imports in core RenderPlan
single-source: no raw-plus-typed caption or generic inline payload
data_flows: typed Inline model -> compiler-owned InlineRun union -> later Preview/Review/DOCX consumers
